observations: Photo 0: Used automatic transmission lying on concrete, dirty and oily, with wiring harness and electrical connectors attached, torque converter housing visible at one end, no readable identification plate, watermark "GEARUP INC".
Photo 1: Salvage yard with multiple used transmissions and engines; the same unit appears on the left side.
Photo 2: Closer view of the same transmission as photo 0, still dirty with no readable model plate.

claims.evidence: No Jeep or model-specific identification plate visible in photos 0-2.
Meaning unclear and not shown in photos.
Photos 0-2 show dirty, oily, used condition.
External photos cannot reveal internal repair history.
Cannot test operation remotely from still photos.

risks.risk: Internal transmission condition (clutches, bearings, solenoids) may be worn or failed.
risks.proof: Video of the unit running on a bench or a functional test clip.

risks.risk: Fitment to the claimed Jeep Wrangler 3.6L 2011-2017 models is unconfirmed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the part number/identification plate or VIN compatibility list.

risks.risk: Internal repairs or prior opening cannot be ruled out.
risks.proof: Service records or photos of the unit before sealing.

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty may not exist or may not transfer.
risks.proof: Photos of the original receipt and warranty documents.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the identification plate/part number on the transmission.
Video of the transmission operating on a test bench.
Photos of the original receipt and warranty documents.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used automatic transmission by type, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working, unknown fitment) despite unverified seller claims.
